The cell: two UR12e on MiR250s, the bench with the module nests and Fixture C, Fixture P, and Fixture B with the finished process module
Chamber assembly (15.5 kg) turned over by both arms holding two legs
Heater stack into the bore: the rod on its bullet passes the two rod O-rings
Spigot O-ring: mandrel on the spigot, pusher stroke
Build module (upside down) into the floor port on Fixture C
Chamber set onto the base plate on Fixture B
Lid cord rolled into the body's gland (roller on arm A)
Chamber turn-over by both arms (F05), every few frames of the checked path
F06: base-plate-to-leg M6 driven up from under the plate (angle-head nutrunner)
C00d: floor-plate M4 driven up through a U-notch (angle-head nutrunner)
F18: rail M4 driven from inside the chamber (angle-head nutrunner)
